remediation_plan.title: Keep deployment blocked until mandatory evidence passes
remediation_plan.evidence: Decision blocked; failed mandatory checks: Security Gate, Trust score issued, Trust score, No high-risk findings; high-risk findings 4; medium-risk findings 6.
remediation_plan.diagnosis: The release fails mandatory controls: Security Gate, Trust score issued, Trust score, No high-risk findings.
remediation_plan.fix: Resolve the P0 model and data items above, generate a new untouched evaluation report, and rerun the complete release gate; do not override the decision manually.
remediation_plan.validation: Every mandatory check must report passed, with no high/critical finding and a final decision of approved or explicitly reviewed conditional according to policy.

remediation_plan.title: Bind the model artifact to a trusted release identity
remediation_plan.evidence: Artifact traffic_rf_v1 uses .joblib; observed SHA-256 is fb61da656964500cc7af0a6986d07a92a42b960f4491244bd1f114c9ee5d2a73.
remediation_plan.diagnosis: Pickle-family artifacts may execute code when loaded, and metadata-only signature claims do not establish an external chain of trust.
remediation_plan.fix: Create a signed .credora package for this exact SHA-256 using an offline Ed25519 private key, distribute only the public trust key to deployment, and reject raw .joblib uploads outside the trusted packaging pipeline.
remediation_plan.validation: Verify the package with an independently supplied public key, then require the extracted model hash to equal the approved release hash before loading it.

remediation_plan.title: Restore the approved runtime artifact
remediation_plan.evidence: Integrity state changed; expected SHA-256 16a0a29a0cc9a166163852f16b51c334118a1fe92e7a7f907245e02e3e18f5e3; observed SHA-256 fb61da656964500cc7af0a6986d07a92a42b960f4491244bd1f114c9ee5d2a73.
remediation_plan.diagnosis: The model currently available to the serving process is missing, changed, or not tied to the approved identity.
remediation_plan.fix: Stop model serving, restore the verified signed artifact from the release store, investigate the replacement event, and rotate deployment credentials if modification was unauthorized.
remediation_plan.validation: Resume serving only after three consecutive integrity checks match the approved SHA-256 and no new tamper alert is created.

remediation_plan.title: Complete dependency security evidence
remediation_plan.diagnosis: The software supply-chain result is incomplete or contains known vulnerable packages.
remediation_plan.fix: Install or repair pip-audit in the scanner environment, confirm vulnerability-database access, and rerun the dependency assessment so the release is based on a completed audit.
remediation_plan.validation: The next scan must complete without an audit error and return zero unresolved high or critical dependency vulnerabilities.

threat_model.method: Risk = Likelihood x Impact; residual risk is reduced only when existing control evidence passes.

protected_assets.name: ML model artifact
protected_assets.description: Serialized classifier or ONNX graph assessed by Credora.
protected_assets.impact: Tampering can change predictions or execute unsafe behavior.

protected_assets.name: Model metadata
protected_assets.description: Declared identity, version, features, labels, and training context.
protected_assets.impact: Manipulation can invalidate checks and misrepresent model behavior.

protected_assets.name: Evaluation dataset
protected_assets.description: Labeled evidence used for classifier and safety measurements.
protected_assets.impact: Poisoning or leakage can produce misleading evaluation results.

protected_assets.name: Dependency files
protected_assets.description: Declared Python packages and versions used by the model.
protected_assets.impact: Compromise can introduce vulnerable or malicious code.

protected_assets.name: Model signatures
protected_assets.description: Cryptographic evidence binding a package to its signer.
protected_assets.impact: Forgery can make an untrusted artifact appear approved.

protected_assets.name: Signing keys
protected_assets.description: Private and trusted public keys used for model and report signatures.

protected_assets.name: Credora trust reports
protected_assets.impact: Tampering can alter the recorded security decision.

protected_assets.name: Trust Score
protected_assets.description: Weighted assurance score issued only after the Security Gate passes.
protected_assets.impact: Manipulation can misstate the model's overall assurance.

protected_assets.name: Deployment decision
protected_assets.description: Security and policy decision controlling production release.
protected_assets.impact: Unauthorized approval can release an unsafe model.

protected_assets.name: Runtime integrity information
protected_assets.description: Approved hashes and later runtime verification observations.
protected_assets.impact: Loss of integrity evidence can hide model replacement.

protected_assets.name: Drift monitoring information
protected_assets.impact: Manipulation can conceal degraded or shifted behavior.

protected_assets.name: User and account information
protected_assets.description: Credentials, roles, sessions, and ownership boundaries.
protected_assets.impact: Compromise can expose reports or authorize malicious uploads.

threat_actors.name: Malicious Model Provider
threat_actors.capabilities: Can prepare model, metadata, dependencies, and evaluation evidence.
threat_actors.objectives: Introduce backdoors, hide weak behavior, or obtain deployment approval.

threat_actors.name: Supply-Chain Attacker
threat_actors.capabilities: Can modify artifacts, packages, dependencies, or distribution paths.
threat_actors.objectives: Inject malicious code or substitute a trusted model.

threat_actors.name: External Attacker
threat_actors.capabilities: Can probe exposed authentication, upload, API, and monitoring interfaces.
threat_actors.objectives: Gain unauthorized access, alter evidence, or submit malicious inputs.

threat_actors.name: Compromised User Account
threat_actors.capabilities: Inherits the permissions and data access of a legitimate account.
threat_actors.objectives: Upload unsafe artifacts, steal reports, or misuse authorized workflows.

threat_actors.name: Malicious Insider
threat_actors.capabilities: May have legitimate access to models, datasets, policies, or administrative actions.
threat_actors.objectives: Manipulate evidence, approve unsafe models, or conceal security findings.

threats.name: Model Artifact Tampering
threats.description: A model is changed after approval or while in transit.
threats.control_result: model_verification: FAIL; runtime_integrity: FAIL; security_gate: FAIL
threats.residual_explanation: A compromised signing key or trusted host remains outside artifact verification.
threats.recommended_action: Reject the artifact and restore a package verified against a trusted signer.

threats.name: Malicious Pickle/Joblib Deserialization
threats.description: A serialized Python model attempts unsafe object construction or code execution.
threats.residual_explanation: A newly discovered unsafe serialization primitive may require an allow-list update.
threats.recommended_action: Use ONNX or a signed package and reject unsupported pickle globals.

threats.name: Vulnerable or Malicious Dependency
threats.description: A declared dependency contains a known vulnerability or malicious package.
threats.residual_explanation: Unknown vulnerabilities and compromised upstream releases can remain undetected.
threats.recommended_action: Upgrade or remove the affected dependency and rerun the scan.

threats.name: Evaluation Dataset Manipulation
threats.description: Evaluation evidence is poisoned, leaked, or selected to inflate performance.
threats.residual_explanation: Credora cannot prove that externally supplied labels are truthful.
threats.recommended_action: Repeat evaluation with an independently sourced, untouched holdout dataset.

threats.name: Model Evasion or Adversarial Input
threats.description: Perturbed traffic features cause security-sensitive predictions to fail.
threats.control_result: adversarial_validation: PASS; robustness_testing: PASS; security_gate: FAIL
threats.residual_explanation: Unmodeled attacks can differ from the evaluated perturbation scenarios.
threats.recommended_action: Retrain with representative evasive traffic and satisfy the Security Gate thresholds.

threats.name: Weak or Unreliable Classifier
threats.description: The classifier has poor generalization, weak classes, or unstable predictions.
threats.control_result: classifier_evaluation: PASS; behavior_analysis: PASS; robustness_testing: PASS
threats.residual_explanation: Observed evaluation performance does not guarantee future production performance.
threats.recommended_action: Improve weak classes and repeat evaluation on independent evidence.

threats.name: Model Backdoor or Suspicious Behaviour
threats.description: A model contains behavior that activates only for hidden or rare patterns.
threats.control_result: behavior_analysis: PASS; model_risk_analyzer: WARNING; explainability: PASS
threats.residual_explanation: A targeted backdoor may remain dormant outside the evaluated inputs.
threats.recommended_action: Investigate suspicious feature reliance and test trigger-oriented datasets.

threats.name: Runtime Model Replacement
threats.description: The deployed artifact is replaced after assessment.
threats.residual_explanation: Monitoring cannot be trusted after full host compromise.
threats.recommended_action: Stop serving the model, restore the approved artifact, and investigate the change.

threats.name: Production Data Drift
threats.description: Production traffic diverges from the assessed data distribution.
threats.residual_explanation: Drift may emerge between monitoring windows or outside captured metadata.
threats.recommended_action: Investigate shifted features and reassess or retrain the model.

threats.name: Trust Report Tampering
threats.description: Stored or exported assessment evidence is altered after generation.
threats.residual_explanation: A stolen signing key can produce apparently valid altered reports.
threats.recommended_action: Sign the report and verify it against an active trusted signer before release.

threats.name: Unauthorized Model Access
threats.description: A user reads or modifies a model assessment outside their authorization.
threats.residual_explanation: Valid credentials can still be abused by a compromised account.
threats.recommended_action: Review account roles, revoke sessions, and inspect audit events.

threats.name: Metadata Manipulation
threats.description: Uploaded metadata misstates identity, features, labels, or policy information.
threats.residual_explanation: Semantically false but structurally valid metadata may require independent review.
threats.recommended_action: Use signed metadata and correct all missing or inconsistent fields.

threats.name: Invalid or Forged Model Signature
threats.description: An artifact carries no valid signature or claims an untrusted signer.
threats.residual_explanation: The check cannot detect a compromised trusted private key.
threats.recommended_action: Reject the package and verify it against a trusted public key.

threats.name: Compromised User Account
threats.description: A legitimate account is used by an unauthorized party.
threats.residual_explanation: Credora does not currently establish that a valid login belongs to the expected person.
threats.recommended_action: Reset credentials, revoke sessions, and review audit activity.

threats.name: Supply-Chain Model Modification
threats.description: A model or its dependencies are modified in the delivery chain.
threats.control_result: model_verification: FAIL; dependency_scanner: WARNING; runtime_integrity: FAIL; security_gate: FAIL
threats.residual_explanation: Compromise before signing remains possible if the build environment is untrusted.
threats.recommended_action: Rebuild from a trusted source and verify the complete signed package.

security_assumptions: The host operating system is trusted.
The Credora backend has not already been compromised.
Signing private keys are securely protected.
Trusted public keys are distributed securely.
Ground-truth evaluation labels are reasonably accurate.
Production metadata supplied to Credora has not already been maliciously altered.
Authorized administrators are trusted unless explicitly modeled otherwise.
out_of_scope_threats: Cryptographic break of Ed25519 or SHA-256
Full compromise of external traffic-capture tools
